events.title: 토트넘 홋스퍼 sign 19-year-old winger Darren Anderton from 포츠머스 for £1.7million. Mike Walker is promoted from reserve team manager to succeed Dave Stringer as manager of 노리치 시티.
Demolition work begins on 맨체스터 유나이티드's famous Stretford End, to make way for an all-seater replacement which will cost £12million to build and be completed next year.

England lose a third right-back when Gary Stevens suffers a stress fracture in a 2–1 friendly win over Finland in Helsinki . Their left winger John Barnes ruptures his Achilles tendon and is also ruled out of the European Championships.

England are given special permission to make additions to their European Championship squad after the official deadline, selecting 맨체스터 시티 defender Keith Curle and QPR winger Andy Sinton as late additions to his squad.

England midfielder 데이비드 플래트 leaves Bari after one year and agrees to join their Italian league rivals 유벤투스 for £6.5million. 해리 레드냅 ends eight years as manager of 본머스 and is succeeded by 토니 퓰리스 . 애스턴 빌라 assistant manager Andy Gray resigns from the position to become a full-time pundit for Sky Sports in their coverage of the new Premier League.

More than a year after first trying to sign him, 라치오 finally sign 폴 개스코인 from 토트넘 홋스퍼 for a fee of £6.5million – a record sale for an English club and the joint highest fee for an English player following 데이비드 플래트's transfer between two Italian clubs yesterday.
England begin their European Championship campaign with a goalless draw with Denmark in Malmö .

England are refused permission to make a further addition to their European Championship squad, after Mark Wright was ruled out by injury and manager 그레이엄 테일러 had wanted to select 토니 애덤스 in his place.
England draw 0–0 with France in their second European Championship group game.
케빈 키건 continues to plot 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's revival bid by signing midfielder Paul Bracewell from 선덜랜드 for £250,000.
The Copa Libertadores is won by São Paulo FC after the defeat of Newell's Old Boys 3–2 via a penalty shootout after a final aggregate score of 1–1.
Despite taking an early lead thanks to 데이비드 플래트, England bow out of the European Championships after two second-half goals put them 2–1 down to Sweden in Stockholm .
크리스 워들 rejects an offer to join 리즈 유나이티드 from 마르세유 . He is now expected to join 셰필드 웬즈데이 for £900,000.
Don Howe resigns as joint manager of 코번트리 시티, leaving Bobby Gould in sole charge.
In Euro 1992 , Denmark surprisingly won 2–0 over Germany at Nya Ullevi , Gothenburg , Sweden.
Due to financial problems Dutch club FC Wageningen is disestablished, after having played its last match one month earlier against NAC 브레다 in the Eerste Divisie .
